simulations.test_environment: Nonproduction portal sandbox + live shared drive policy check
simulations.synthetic_data_used: Synthetic Applicant A-901 (fictional student, placeholder essay, dummy transcript PDF)
steps_completed: Submitted synthetic applicant A-901 at intake
Traced portal storage and backup copy
Identified manual CSV export path into Example Shared Drive
Flagged unverified offline reviewer downloads for remediation
simulations.actual_observation: Portal storage and backup ownership were clear, but scoring calibration CSVs exported to Example Shared Drive lacked documented deletion verification and allowed reviewer download.
simulations.expected_result: Every transfer and stored copy has an owner, approved purpose, access limit, and disposition path.
simulations.limitations: Did not inspect personal volunteer reviewer devices (out of scope).

simulations.test_environment: Authorized finance tabletop simulation (no live banking edits)

simulations.actual_observation: Fraudulent change was halted immediately; independent callback and dual-approval gate both worked as documented.
simulations.expected_result: Payment does not change until approved confirmation through a trusted pre-existing channel.
simulations.limitations: Tested with primary Finance Officer; backup finance approver scheduled for next cycle drill.

findings.affected_process_system: Review / Example Shared Drive & Portal Exports
findings.title: Reviewers may retain local applicant exports after the review cycle
findings.description: Scoring CSVs and essay excerpts exported to Example Shared Drive can be downloaded locally without tracked disposition.
findings.evidence_observation: EV-DATA-001 inventory lists the portal but does not account for downloaded CSV files or reviewer local copies.
findings.impact: Sensitive applicant essays and grades may remain accessible outside the controlled scholarship portal after awards close.
findings.likelihood_rationale: High likelihood during seasonal volunteer review without technical download limits.
findings.existing_mitigations: Shared Drive external anonymous links are disabled.
findings.proposed_action: Inventory reviewer downloads, restrict bulk export permissions, disable download on calibration folders where supported, and verify post-cycle purge.
findings.verification_steps: Sampled reviewer account cannot export outside authorized limits and end-of-cycle deletion check passes.

findings.affected_process_system: Example Shared Drive / Seasonal Reviewer Offboarding
findings.title: Former seasonal volunteer reviewers retained shared-folder view links
findings.description: Two departed Spring reviewers still had active view permissions to the committee calibration folder.
findings.evidence_observation: EV-IAM-002 spot check found 2/5 sampled former reviewers retained active access after portal accounts were disabled.
findings.impact: Unauthorized access to committee scoring records and applicant excerpts by individuals no longer serving.
findings.likelihood_rationale: Verified failure in recent offboarding sample.
findings.existing_mitigations: Portal accounts were disabled; the two discovered links were removed immediately upon discovery.
findings.proposed_action: Add Shared Drive and OAuth grant checks to the mandatory post-cycle offboarding checklist with second-person verification.
findings.verification_steps: Complete Simulation 2 with a synthetic former reviewer showing zero residual logins or folder links.

findings.affected_process_system: Example Scholarship Portal & Donor CRM Backups
findings.title: No controlled backup restore test performed in 18 months
findings.description: Team relies on automated backup-success email alerts without testing whether records and attachments actually restore intact.
findings.evidence_observation: No restore log exists for current or prior cycle.
findings.impact: Ransomware or portal corruption during application or disbursement windows could cause unrecoverable data loss.
findings.likelihood_rationale: Untested backups frequently fail silently under recovery stress.
findings.proposed_action: Execute a scoped nonproduction backup restore using the Backup Restore Log template and verify credential isolation.
findings.verification_steps: Completed restore log recording elapsed time, verified record counts, opened attachments, and isolated credentials.

findings.title: Vendor subprocessor register and deletion clauses are stale
findings.description: EV-VEND-001 is over one year old and does not confirm current email-relay subprocessors or written end-of-contract deletion confirmation.
findings.impact: Blind spots in third-party data handling and unclear breach notification / exit obligations.
findings.likelihood_rationale: SaaS vendors regularly add subprocessors and AI features between annual renewals.
findings.existing_mitigations: Primary vendor contract includes 72-hour incident notice language.
findings.proposed_action: Request updated subprocessor list, scoped assurance report, and deletion SLA ahead of renewal; flag legal clauses for counsel review.
findings.verification_steps: Updated Vendor Register with current review date and synthetic data export check.

findings.title: AI provider zero-training and retention terms not yet verified in writing
findings.description: Staff policy prohibits uploading identifiable essays, but account-tier retention and training opt-out terms have not been documented.
findings.evidence_observation: EV-AI-001 notes vendor terms still pending verification.
findings.impact: Risk of accidental prompt retention or model training if staff enter sensitive drafting notes.
findings.likelihood_rationale: Default consumer AI tiers often retain prompts unless enterprise/opt-out controls are verified.
findings.existing_mitigations: Policy limits current usage to synthetic practice texts and general outreach drafts.
findings.proposed_action: Verify account tier zero-training/retention settings in admin console, record proof in EV-AI-001, and run Simulation 5.
findings.verification_steps: Admin screenshot reference of zero-training setting plus completed Simulation 5 prompt-injection log.

actions.verification_step: Run Simulation 2 on synthetic reviewer account with zero residual access.
